cost_notes: free; no key; be polite (small bounded lookups)
entity_identifiers: publicDeviceRecordKey (GUDID's own immutable record key; equals openFDA public_device_record_key)
premarket submission numbers (510(k)/PMA) where the labeler recorded them
UNKNOWN - no company registry id; company_name is a free-text labeler string
historical_coverage: GUDID holds 5,182,695 device-identifier records (openFDA 2026-11-03 export); AccessGUDID serves the current published version of each record, not its version history
known_limitations: AccessGUDID and openFDA /device/udi.json publish the SAME GUDID record: the same DI returns the same publicDeviceRecordKey on both, so they are one evidence item and must be de-duplicated (verified in this probe), never counted as two independent sources
publicVersionDate is a version stamp - using it as a publication date makes every record look republished; devicePublishDate is the correct per-record clock
lookup is by DI: there is no documented bulk enumeration on this endpoint, so a full mirror has to come from the release files instead
a GUDID record states labeler and brand, not the legal manufacturer group, so company linkage relies on the alias index over free-text labeler names
absence of a record does not mean absence of the device: GUDID covers US-marketed devices only
licence: GUDID is a US federal regulatory dataset that FDA republishes under a CC0 1.0 dedication (open.fda.gov/license/, verified). NLM's own AccessGUDID terms page was not opened in this pass, so the NLM-side wording is UNKNOWN and must be checked before bulk redistribution
rate_limits: no documented numeric limit on the pages opened; NLM asks for polite use, so we paced at 1.0 s per request and kept each probe to a handful of lookups
research_value: GUDID is the only device source with a genuine per-record publication date (devicePublishDate), which is exactly the clock a bitemporal device study needs; combined with the premarket_submissions field it turns a DI into a 510(k)/PMA number, i.e. it is the official bridge between device identity and US clearance identity.
timestamp_fields: devicePublishDate (per-record first publication in GUDID - the real publication clock)
publicVersionDate (version stamp; NOT a first-publication date)
update_frequency: continuous (GUDID is updated daily; the release files are published daily)
